subject.title: fix(codex): continue after source-reply delivery instead of terminating turn

question: Which rebased branch should own the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106961 after live continuation and exactly-once delivery proof is supplied?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107388 overlap substantially, while current main has also refactored the same bridge; choosing the landing branch and any schema-guidance remainder requires maintainer ownership rather than parallel merges.

options.title: Consolidate one canonical branch
options.body: Rebase both candidates against current main, retain the strongest runtime, telemetry, schema-guidance, and test coverage in one branch, add live Discord/Codex proof, and close the other as superseded.

options.title: Land this PR only
options.body: Use this branch as the canonical fix after rebasing and proving continuation plus exactly-once delivery, with a follow-up only if the `final` tool guidance remains unclear.

options.title: Land the overlapping PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107388 if its added model-facing guidance is preferred and it gains equivalent current-main and live behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Consolidate one canonical branch
recommendation.body: Rebase both candidates against current main, retain the strongest runtime, telemetry, schema-guidance, and test coverage in one branch, add live Discord/Codex proof, and close the other as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: The generic continuation and duplicate-suppression contract originated in this person's merged work, making them the strongest history-based routing candidate for the canonical behavior choice.
